patterns: Official MCP JSON-RPC transport with hand-written schema-aware domain commands

novel_features.name: Local scope map
novel_features.description: See the captured business, account and phone relationships for an explicitly selected scope, including gaps and shared-account roles.
novel_features.rationale: This uses saved whatsapp_biz_businesses, whatsapp_biz_accounts and whatsapp_biz_phone_numbers responses and their capture-scope metadata to join known relationships and expose unresolved links with no external dependencies.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use before preparing an operation to verify the captured business/account/phone relationships and evidence gaps.

novel_features.name: Template component checklist
novel_features.description: Extract the values a saved template needs and flag components the MCP send tool cannot express, without sending or inventing parameter values.
novel_features.rationale: This uses a saved whatsapp_biz_get_template component document and the captured whatsapp_biz_send_message input contract to extract placeholder paths and supported versus unsupported parameter channels with no external dependencies.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use before composing template values to identify unsupported component mappings without sending.

novel_features.name: MCP catalog drift
novel_features.description: Compare saved MCP catalogs and identify removed tools, new required inputs and changed schema paths that could break saved commands.
novel_features.rationale: This uses two locally saved tools/list catalogs and their exact input/output schemas to compute tool additions/removals, required-input additions and schema-path changes with no external dependencies.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use before updating scripts against the beta MCP contract.

novel_features.name: Captured asset changes
novel_features.description: Compare two captures of the same selected scope and see changed fields, additions and evidence gaps without mistaking incomplete pages for deletions.
novel_features.rationale: This uses two locally stored, time-stamped MCP response snapshots with identical business/app/account/filter scope to compute structural changes and completeness-aware additions or removals with no external dependencies.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when resuming integration work to compare the exact same scope against its previous capture.

novel_features.name: Cross-account template comparison
novel_features.description: Compare two explicitly chosen captured templates across accounts, with field and component differences tied to their original account and capture time.
novel_features.rationale: This uses two explicitly selected saved whatsapp_biz_get_template responses plus their account/template IDs and capture metadata to compute a field-and-component diff with no external dependencies.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when reviewing two explicitly selected account-specific template documents.

narrative.headline: Operate the official WhatsApp Business MCP with reviewable writes and captured evidence for integration checks.
narrative.value_prop: Discover the correct business assets, inspect actual setup state, and prepare schema-aware operations. Compare saved configurations, templates and MCP contracts with explicit scope and capture times.
narrative.auth_narrative: Meta OAuth is required. Use --codex-auth (or WHATSAPP_BUSINESS_USE_CODEX_AUTH=1) to explicitly read the existing native Codex Meta OAuth credential on this Mac. Run auth codex --launch when that native session needs sign-in. An independently registered client was rejected by Meta; independent OAuth is not claimed. A resource-specific bearer can instead be supplied through the configured credential seam.

quickstart.comment: Inspect the local CLI health-check plan without credentials or network.
Discover authorized business scopes before selecting one.

narrative.when_to_use: Use for the official Meta WhatsApp Business Tools MCP and its authorized business assets. Start with discovery, choose the business explicitly and read captured scope metadata before local comparisons.
anti_triggers: Do not use for personal WhatsApp chat history or inbox triage.
Do not use for Cloud API capabilities absent from this official MCP.
Do not infer send eligibility, pricing or delivery from local snapshots.
